title: Days' Supply and Packages per Fill on a Tailwise Pharmacy Renewal Order
content:
*Pharmacy dispensing basis.*

## Days' supply per fill

A Tailwise Pharmacy renewal asks the veterinarian for the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill, never more than the class's maximum days' supply per fill, in whole days. The class maximum is the figure the fill-limits schedule sets for the prescription's class.

## Packages per fill

The packages per fill of the renewal are its days' supply per fill multiplied by the packages the renewed prescription dispenses per day of supply, that is, the renewed prescription's packages per fill divided by its days' supply per fill.

## Worked examples (hypothetical prescriptions)

| Renewed prescription | Class maximum per fill | Days' supply asked for | Packages per day of supply on the renewed prescription | Packages per fill of the renewal |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30 days, 1 package per fill | 30 days | 30 | 1 divided by 30 | 30 multiplied by one thirtieth: 1 |
| 45 days, 3 packages per fill | 30 days | 30 (held to the class maximum) | 3 divided by 45, one fifteenth | 30 multiplied by one fifteenth: 2 |
| 28 days, 2 packages per fill | 30 days | 28 | 2 divided by 28, one fourteenth | 28 multiplied by one fourteenth: 2 |

## Points of reading

- The days' supply is the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill as written on it.
- The packages per fill keep the renewed prescription's packages per day of supply: a shorter days' supply gives proportionally fewer packages.
